# Trynext Lifestyle

> Bangladesh's #1 premium custom print-on-demand e-commerce platform. Customers design and order custom-printed apparel, mugs, caps, and lifestyle products online, with nationwide delivery across all 64 districts of Bangladesh.

## About

Trynext Lifestyle (trynext.shop) is a full-stack custom print-on-demand e-commerce store based in Bangladesh. Founded to bring premium-quality custom apparel to the Bangladeshi market, Trynext allows anyone to design their own t-shirts, hoodies, long sleeves, mugs, caps, and waterbottles using an in-browser Design Studio — with no minimum order quantity.

- **Website**: https://trynext.shop
- **WhatsApp**: +8801903426915
- **Email**: support@trynextshop.com
- **Location**: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- **Delivery**: All 64 districts of Bangladesh + International

## Products

Trynext offers 6 customisable product categories:

- **Unisex T-Shirt** — 230GSM premium cotton, sizes XS–XXXL, 8 colour options, front & back print
- **Unisex Hoodie** — 320GSM fleece, sizes XS–XXXL, 10 colour options, front & back print
- **Unisex Long Sleeve** — 240GSM cotton, sizes XS–XXXL, 10 colour options, front & back print
- **Coffee Mug** — 11oz ceramic, dishwasher safe, 360° wrap print, 10 colour options
- **Structured Cap** — 6-panel cotton, adjustable strap, front panel print, 6 colour options
- **Waterbottle** — 500ml stainless steel, insulated, wrap print, 5 colour options

All products are customisable. Customers can upload their own designs, add text, or use the AI-powered design generator.

## Design Studio

The Design Studio is Trynext's browser-native product customiser. Features include:
- Upload your own artwork (JPG/PNG/WebP up to 10MB)
- AI art generation from text prompts
- Custom text with 100+ Google Fonts
- Real-time photorealistic garment mockup preview
- Front and back view for all apparel
- Save designs for later
- Pre-built design templates

URL: https://trynext.shop/design-studio

## Payment Methods

- Cash on Delivery (COD) — most popular, available across Bangladesh
- bKash mobile banking
- Nagad mobile banking
- Rocket (DBBL) mobile banking

## Shipping & Delivery

- Express delivery: 1–3 business days (Dhaka)
- Standard delivery: 3–7 business days (nationwide, all 64 districts)
- Free shipping on orders above ৳1500
- International shipping available

## Pricing

- Custom T-Shirts: Starting from ৳399
- Custom Hoodies: Starting from ৳799
- Custom Long Sleeves: Starting from ৳549
- Custom Mugs: Starting from ৳299
- Custom Caps: Starting from ৳449
- Custom Waterbottles: Starting from ৳599

## Gift Hampers

Trynext offers curated premium gift hamper sets — ideal for birthdays, corporate gifting, and special occasions. Custom-branded hampers with multiple items are available.

URL: https://trynext.shop/hampers

## Blog

The Trynext blog covers custom apparel tips, fashion trends, garment care guides, and design inspiration for the Bangladeshi market.

URL: https://trynext.shop/blog

## Technology

- Frontend: React 19 + Vite, deployed on Cloudflare Pages (global CDN)
- Backend: Express.js REST API, deployed on Render
- Database: Neon PostgreSQL (serverless)
- Mobile: Expo React Native (iOS & Android)
- PWA: Installable as a mobile app from the browser
